title: Self-petting watchdog Trojan defeating system recovery
description: Review the RTL source of a watchdog timer peripheral (wdt_top) and its accompanying documentation to determine whether reset_req can be trusted to assert at the programmed timeout under all bus traffic. Produce a JSON analysis report identifying any logic path that can alter counter reload/timeout behavior outside the documented register interface.
